exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs Vaginal delivery)
cohort: Randomly selected pregnant women and their fetuses.
finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had higher rcSO2 levels at 1 minute of life than those born via Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonatal cFTOE at 1 minute of life was significantly higher in Cesarean-delivered newborns versus naturally born neonates.
